scripts.functions:check: node scripts/wrangler.mjs pages functions build functions --outdir .pages-build
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply worklog --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply worklog --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run db:check:remote && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs pages deploy
scripts.deploy:quick: npm run db:check:remote && npm run build && node scripts/wrangler.mjs pages deploy
